neighbours.label: an abstract framing noun that sets up a name or existential claim ('this thing called X', 'no such thing as', 'this journey called', 'the miracle of'); a literal, physical 'thing' stays lower

I fell in love with this crazy sport called rugby.
There was no such thing as a weekend off on the farm.
Welcome to this strange experience called retirement.
